{{Top|leg}}
'''Trade Federation escort cruisers''' were [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruisers]], used around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], to patrol the space that surrounded a typical [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] defense structure. This defense structure consisted of two huge [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] split-ring battleships surrounded by six armed [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|''Hardcell''-class interstellar transports]] in a pyramid-point defensive shell. Several escort cruisers would have been arrayed into a patrol cloud but were not designed to take on any powerful enemy, like the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]], without [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] support.

==History==
[[Vicelord]] [[Siv Kav]] and [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] used seven Trade Federation escort cruisers in their failed attempt to defeat [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] and the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force.

==Behind the scenes==
It is unknown if this vessel and the [[Trade Federation Cruiser (Second Battle of Lok)]] are of the same class or different unspecified designs. They both exist in the same era and are of similar name and seeming role, but they are never confirmed as the same type of ship.
